title: Riot Squad BAR EDTN Limited Edition Apple Lime Chill 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Apple Lime Chill from Riot Squad’s Bar Edition Limited Edition range is a sweet, sharp and frosty fruit medley inspired by disposable-style flavours. Crisp Green Apple delivers a bright, juicy top note that’s quickly followed by a punch of tangy Lime, finished with a brisk Menthol exhale for a clean, chilly aftertaste. The result is a superbly-balanced flavour profile that’s both vivid and refreshing. Mint Infused Formulated with nicotine salts, this e-liquid delivers fast nicotine satisfaction with a smooth yet satisfyingly tactile throat hit compared to traditional freebase blends. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths, it's ideal for vapers who prefer discreet vapour and clear, consistent flavour from low-powered MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits, vape pens, and starter devices. Riot Squad’s Bar Edition Nic Salt range is made in the UK and designed to replicate the intense sweetness and icy profiles of disposable vape flavours—but in a format that’s more versatile, and better suited to long-term use. Whether you're new to vaping or seeking familiar flavours in a refillable format, this Limited Edition collection from Riot Squad offers a punchy alternative for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping.
